## Notes

Lo-Fi Games; Chris Hunt worked alone until 2013; one of the first Steam Early Access games in March 2013; full release 2018-12-06; Windows; limbs damaged or severed and replaced with prosthetics; skills level through actions; world states react to deaths of notable figures.
